nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Cucumber Herbal Alcohol Free Toner

avis.texte: They need to make sure to ship this toner in a box & not just in a bubble padded envelope. It arrievd broken & leaked everywhere. Wanted to take this fo travel but now cant because it was broken and half empty. Wasted my money.

I have been using this product for quite a few years. I have dry skin and it was actually my doctor who recommended I use this toner instead of any facial cleanser in the mornings. It works great without my face feeling dried out. In the evenings I use it to remove any cleanser residue.
I dont care how different yoir skin care routine is. You NEED this in it. Ive got three different people obsessed with it because of how quick you notice a difference using it 🙌
I feel so clean after using the cucumber toner. I cannot go without it. . .
I usually love everything Kiehls. But this product i must say I don't. Its drying and doesn't give my skin the prep its needs for my other products. Just didn't work for me.

I had high hopes for this based on the description and the great reviews. I was looking for something that would add some hydration to my dry-combo, slightly-sensitive skin, and leave my face feeling refreshed. The first day I tried it I thought I really liked it and left my skin visibly dewy. Every time I have used it since, it has left my skin irritated...almost like a slight burning sensation. I really like the hydrating effects of this, but I can't handle the irritating feeling. Thought I had a bad batch at first because my skin is not all that sensitive. But I researched the ingredients and it could be the campor, which apparently is a known irritant. I wish I knew that before buying.
Great for my sensitive skin! It prepares the skin for application of your next steps perfectly. I will be buying again!
This is my absolute favorite toner. It is soothing on my sensitive, combination skin and doesn't cause breakouts. It's expensive but worth it!
I love the way this toner feels but with some of my other products it feels tingly on my skin which concerns me. I will still continue to use the product but I will be aware of possible irritation.
I have very sensitive skin and growing up in Chicago, this toner is perfect, for me. I've been using this product since I was 15 years old and I'm 45 now.

avis.titre: This toner is the best ever and makes my skin glow
avis.texte: Absolutely love this stuff and the cleanser too Please don't ever discontinue because my skin will be very upset. I was a huge fan of the cannabis herbal cleanser and it got discontinued and this toner and cleanser actually made me happier i absolutely love the way the my skin feels and looks so thank you Kiehl's for making me and my skin happy ❤️
Love this toner, my skin loves this toner and has never looked better. I use it morning and night before moisturizing.
Another great product. It seems to do as described. My pores are smaller, my skin tone seems more even or consistent. I like how it feels after I shave too.
Great product when my skin is starting to flare up due to an allergic reaction to something or just an irritation. It's effective and gentle at the same time!
This is a very comfortable, refreshing and healing toner. I sue it when I need to ease and offer my skin reprieve, but I always use a toner regardless
I have been using this toner for few years already. It's not harsh on your skin but it cleans further ur skin leaving it smooth for the moisturi
Leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed. It lasts a long time before having to replenish it.

avis.titre: The Toner stand up for what it supposed to do
avis.texte: This product definitely helps with the finishing of your skin after washing.
Refreshing... Use it twice a day, and it is great for the transition between cleansing and the next steps.
It's also perfect for me with sensitive skin whose skin condition changes easily depending on the season and environment.
I love this toner and always make sure I don't run out of it. It's light and gentle on my sensitive skin. Would highly recommend it.
This toner leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed, and the wrinkle reducing moisturizer goes on smoothly afterwards
I've had this for about 6 months and don't notice any difference. Don't love the scent either
can use for a while. Good price and mild. Highly recommended.
Makes my dry skin feel soft and refreshed. Have used for several years and love the way it makes my skin feel!!

avis.titre: FAB for winter or anyone with dry skin!
avis.texte: I have dry skin in the winter and totally rely on this toner to calm skin before moisturizing. I put this into a spray bottle and find that works well. A few micro-mists of this beauty are so refreshing!

My daughters were dealing with skin issues for a long time. We stopped into Kiel's in NYC. They did a skin test and recommended these products. It's been 2 years of using them with no more skin issues. The products are gentle but effective.

I have dry skin that's prone to redness and eczema but this calms my skin. I wipe it on my face and neck after cleansing at night and rinsing in the morning. My moisturizer absorbs much nicer and feels more refreshed. Been using for 5 months and my eczema flares have stopped—even in the winter months.

I really love the cucumber toner…been using it for years. This toner does what it's supposed to do…tones my skin after I wash my face and before I use serum and moisturizer. I use it everyday. Don't know what I'd do without it.

avis.titre: Give your skin time to adjust
avis.texte: It took about a week for my skin to adjust to the new product, but of course, that's just me. Now I love the product - very soothing and refreshing.
This product feels cool to the skin and does not irritate. Makes my skin feel softer.
The package arrived and the box seemed ok. However when I opened it I was surprised the bottle cap is broken and I cant use the toner if it would be exposed like this with a broken cap

avis.titre: This product keep my  skin younger .
avis.texte: I has been using this products over 40 years now. This product is the reason why her skin look at least 25 years younger than her age.

So I tried samples of this and loved it. Bought a full bottle and added it to my routine using once a day at night, but it started to dry my skin out. I would use Ultra facial cream and centella Sensitive Cica cream - still dry.
I see here it's listed without paragons, but on other sites it lists that it has Methylparabens. Can you clarify here? What about Pthalates?

I used to use this toner ~2000-2011 and loved it. I purchased again in 2020 but it's not the same. Color is darker now, and the cucumber fresh scent is now overly herbal. In 9 months my bottle is still practically full (just below the top edge of the label) because I rarely use it. Not my favorite anymore.
packaging is crap! Looks awful and defective. Not sure who packed this but would you want to use this?

I have combination skin and couldn't find much that helped. even my dermatologist was having a hard time with me. This saved me. I swear it's the reason my skin has been clearer. it's moisturizing enough for me and feels good. cucumber is good for the skin which is why I was okay with trying this. been using it for months now and it's made me feel better about my skin routine.
I have always found toners drying. This one feels great. Very calming and I have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Great product that goes bad fast.
avis.texte: After about three weeks after purchase the toner began to have a sharp almost-alcohol smell to it (I store it in a cool, dry, dark place). I exchanged it for another... once again it smelled different after a few weeks. Even the store associates noticed it the second time I came back when I made them do a side by side comparison with a new bottle.

avis.titre: Great toner for combination skin, not crazy about smell.
avis.texte: I fell in love with the calendula flower toner of this brand but for the price difference, I decided to try this one. Works great and certainly a good deal. I'm not crazy about the smell and feel like I need to use more of this one to get the same effect as the aforementioned toner.

I've been using this product after cleansing my face with the Kiehls Ultra Facial Cleanser for a few weeks now, and I love it! It's super gentle on my skin and leaves a nice clean feeling behind without being tight or drying. I like that it gives me an extra layer of cleansing after washing. I highly recommend!

This is a perfect toner for using after a double cleanse. It's non-drying and doesn't sting. Very comforting to the skin. The smell isn't bad as people have stated. Smells like a tattoo shop which smells very clean. This toner isn't for you if you're looking for one with a cucumber or spa type scent.

This toner is the BEST I have ever tried. It leaves your skin soft, fresh and smooth. I tried it a few years ago after developing an allergic rash on my face. It was amazing. I have been hooked ever since. Kiehls products are so great, and this is a staple for me. Thank you Kiehls.

avis.titre: Love love love. The only toner I use now
avis.texte: I see a lot of mixed reviews. I think maybe this product isn't for people with sensitive skin as it claims but it definitely works on dry skin. I have ezcema and this toner has changed my world for the better! Love it! Use it twice a day.
Made my face break out in a way I have never broken out before. I have dry/sensitive skin.

The Cucumber Toner is very gentle. The recipe is no alcohol. The Hall must be moisture. Gentle to the skin, help the skin to be smooth naturally. Keep the balance and help the skin tighten up. Give the clean skin. Out of smooth, smooth, smooth skin and smooth skin. I feel that the my skin is healthy and beautiful. The best toner for me.

I really like this productive. I find it very refreshing and soothing. It's helped with acne and removes leftover makeup after I've used a cleanser. I have pretty dry skin, so maybe it works better for that type of skin.

I really like this productive. I find it very refreshing and soothing. It's helped with acne and removes leftover makeup after I've used a cleanser. I have pretty dry skin, so maybe it works better for that type of skin.

Love, this product on my 5th bottle, been using for years. The cucumber smell can be a little nauseating at time, but the results of evening out my skin tone is fantastic. I find spraying it on my face as a mist in the morning and then putting a moisturizer over it helps balance out my facial/neck tone.
This toner is a nice product that feels good on my skin. I believe I've seen a more even skin tone since using it.

I love Kiehls but this was a miss for me. Made my skin inflamed with red patches and did not work as far as cleaning my face or any makeup left behind from cleansing. I gave it a couple chances (taking a break in between to make sure the inflammation was from the toner) and it still disappointed me. Maybe this will work if you don't have sensitive skin.

While suitable for any skin type, this toner is a life saver for dry skin. The alcohol-free formula is not drying and the cucumber has a soothing, calming effect on the skin, especially after a deep cleaning mask. I really like Kiehl's focus on curating products for all skin types. There is something for everyone and every skin concern.

I love this product and will use it until it stops working for me, but traveling with it is awful. I have had 2 bottles that have been screwed tight and the top snapped down but it leaked a lot. Luckily i always put liquid things in ziploc bags when i travel but this shouldn?t be happening. It is wasteful and nerve wrecking.

I have used Kiehl?s exclusively for many years and have avoided toners thinking they would be drying on my sensitive skin. Recently read how toners are an important step in the daily routine. I tried the Calendula trial sz and after a wk my skin did feel a bit too dry. It does say it?s for normal/oily skin. So I purchased this Cucumber toner. Wow. I use as directed twice a day and really see a difference. My skin?s texture and color has really improved. And not drying at all on my over 50 sensitive skin. SO happy with this product!
I use this every morning to "wake up" and it works. It's refreshing and wipes away my nighttime moisturizer to get me ready for my morning routine.

I have never used toners related to thinking toners just dry your skin out. My skin is already dry even more in the winter. My skin is sensitive. I received a sample of this toner. It was great my skin actually felt great and didn't dry out. It actually helped my dry, sensitive, roscae skin. Education is key to all things. Plus for me it was great because the scent wasn't strong.

avis.titre: I really do not like the scent
avis.texte: I am not sure if this product is as wonderful as everyone else felt, but I think it is ok. I did not find it "magical". However, I really do not like the scent/smell of it, I guess it is how it supposed to smell like?

avis.titre: This toner does my face wonders!
avis.texte: I've never used toner before and I was so skeptical of it. I did a ton of research before finally settling on this one and it is the best skin care decision I've ever made! My skin feels so soft, clean, and hydrated after using this. I use it twice a day: once in the morning before applying makeup and once before I go to bed before applying moisturizer. My skin has become softer and my complexion has cleared up so much! I definitely recommend it!!

I got this product at a charity sale where I worked the cash register. SO many people were purchasing this brand I decided to try this product and i think it is really a wonderful cleanser. I have very sensitive skin and most products sting and burn even where there is no alcohol in the ingredient. I returned to the store and bought another bottle and have tried a couple other products. This one I like the best so far.
unlike others, I don't notice an unpleasant scent when used. I use this toner every morning and night and can't say enough good things - it leaves my skin clean, soft, and wonderfully hydrated.

avis.titre: Great Toner For Dry and Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: This is actually one of my favorite toners. It's mild, healing, alcohol-free, and great for those with dry skin. I do agree with other comments about the smell - it's not as pleasant as others, but it's easy to get over. I like how there is multiple size choices and how they are decently priced. Makes me happy to find a toner I love and that I can afford!

I love this toner, that's why inalways order the bigger bottle. However it seems like every time when I receive the bottle, the lid part is broken into two pieces, this is the second time now! I really enjoy the product, but I do have problem wit the quality of the lid. I bought the 16.9 fl. Oz bottle which would last quite a while, with the lid being broken, I really don't like it! I really really hope that next time when I order this product, the lid is good!

I have used more than ten different brands of toner, but none of them smells this badly! It smells exactly like some kind of medicine in hospital. aspirin maybe? formalin maybe? I have to hold my breath while putting it on for the first time! Why none of you mentioned this in reviews? I really wish I could return it for free considering that there are no Kiehl's stores near my city. BTW the lid of the bottle cracked into three pieces, you should really be more careful packing up the package.
I love love love this toner. It makes my skin so soft and glowing. Most toners have alcohol on them which is really bad for the skin! Please Kiehl's don't ever discontinue this!!!!
This one is very good for sensitive skins. It feels very clean after you use it. I bought the biggest bottle for my sister, and she loves it very much!
I have been using this toner for more than 4 years and at least 10 bottles. This is perfect for summer cuz its not oily. And I like use this toner for making masks. Strong recommend!

This is my favorite toner. The best thing I love about it is that it is really hydrating but does noting else :) I actually hates those products that claim to do a lot of things but are sticky and irritating. This one is light and soothing and keeps the face hydrated all day long, which is quite enough for a toner!

avis.titre: A staple in my skin care routine
avis.texte: This product is EVRYTHING! I have used it for years. Love that it's alcohol free, calming and soothing for sensitive and dry skin.

I have always been incredibly leery of and reluctant to use toners. They had always left my face feeling tight, stretched, and in danger of cracking open like a parched desert. I originally purchased this product as a last ditch "surely not everyone can be wrong" attempt to compile a skin care routine that included a toner. I now understand what all the fuss is about and this product has become a integral step in my skin care ritual. It leaves my skin feeling clean and firmed without the nasty dried and stretched sensation. I also think it reduces the size of my pores with regular use, but this may be a placebo effect. :) Nonetheless, this is my favourite toner, the only one I will use, and I try very hard never to run out.
I love that this toner is lightweight with no odor..however my skin does not feel clean like I thought it would.
It really works on my thirsty face. When applying on, I feel the pores are absorbing. My face is softer and smooth after applying it.
I have sensitive skin, use this after cleansing & removes any make up that may be left while firming & tones, in addition, hydrates your skin. When done, finish with ultra facial moisturizer.

The last thing my skin needs is a drying toner, but one thing it really needs is a toner that will remove all my makeup. Thankfully, the Cucumber Toner cleanses my skin well and doesn't dry it at all. This is just what I was looking for! Plus, at this price point, it is especially attractive :)
I wish I would have been able to check the full ingredient list prior to purchase. I wasn't happy with what was in this so I didn't even use it. Returning this product.

I have dry skin, that's prone to be super sensitive; almost everything breaks me out. Until I tried this I couldn't find a toner that didn't either dry my skin or break me out. This toner is wonderful, it removes any last traces of makeup or cleanser and give my skin a very clean, nice finish. I will be buying again and would recommend to anyone with dry and or sensitive skin.

avis.titre: The reason my skin has been flawless
avis.texte: I adore this toner. I was never a fan of toners in general as they always seem to be alcohol-based and would make my skin more dry than it already is. I use this toner after using the rare earth deep pore daily cleanser. Three days after using it, my skin was break-out free. It doesn't sting, or have a smell. It's the real deal. I adore it!

Great for sensitive skin. Super mild and refreshing. Not my favorite of the toner line-up. Thinking this may be great for teens or beginners in skin care. I like to chill it in the fridge before using.
I always make a toner mask with it every night before I go sleep, then put the moisture on. Great product, keep my skin away from dry and thirsty.
clean and refreshing, the toner has good value, but i don't like its smell.

Love this product. The smell is nice and refreshing, cool texture and lightweight. I have blemishes from old acne and trying to soften the look. I have only been using for a week, but love how it feels,
This cucumber toner feels nice and has been good to my fairly sensitive skin. Using it at times during the day when you need a little pick-me-up is perfect.

Love this toner. Tried it on a whim, since I have oily skin that can be prone to occasional breakouts. Since I have been using this toner my skin is less oily and I have had virtually zero breakouts. I even bought the larger bottle the second time around. This is a keeper!

I wanted a toner that was gentle, yet still effective. I noticed that my skin does not respond well to any type of oil -- even the natural oils in this product. I broke out constantly! This made my skin feel sticky and heavy, not for me.
I love this toner. I used Calendula Herbal Extract Alcohol-Free Toner before I bought cucumber because everyone says calendula is awesome. I think cucumber is better for dry skin.

avis.titre: Not as gentle as I was expecting
avis.texte: Label states that this is for dry and sensitive skin, but I would recommend this more for oily or normal skin. Kiehl's calendula and ultra toners are much more gentle and much better for my combo/dry/40's skin. I wish I could return but no kiehls store nearby and don't want to do the hassle of mailing.

avis.titre: Cucumber Toner is an Effective, Excellent Product
avis.texte: I love this toner and have used it for many years alone or in conjuction with Kiehl's Amazonian Clay Cleanser, Kiehl's Line Reducer , Kiehl's Sunsceen and Kiehl's Avacodo Eye Treatment as well as other Kiehl's products- then fiinsh nightly with Kiehl's Midnight Recovery. The Cucumber Toner is an excellent medium refreshing and calming skin my skin on it's own or as a preparation for application of other great Kiehl's products It is not drying at all. I apply to eye area with cotton pads finding it reduces puffiness and darkness in the eye area. I love this toner which is gentle enough for eyes and sensitive skin.- No burning or stinging. It's a cult fav for me. This also stands out on it's own as a great Toner refreshing gently- I've even put in little spray bottle for a refresher on the go. Yes, I'm versatile with this product.- Love it !

I got this on sale and I am really loving it. The colors definitely need a primer or else they lose most of the non-black pigment. You can create a wide variety of looks with this palette, not just night time looks. I really enjoy the packaging, very sleek and easy for storage. I wish it had come with a Perversion pencil rather than Zero since I have a lot of Zero. I haven't had any issues with chalkiness or fallout. Most also make very good wet liners.

I love this eye shadow! The shimmer in the colors looks fantastic. My only complaint would be the fact that Cobra, Barracuda, and Libertine are all very dark and don't show the gold, silver and green colors off very well. Jet is my absolute favorite out of all of them. Overall, this is a great palette if you're looking to dip into your dark side!
This product is cool, but I didn't realize how dark these colors were. All of the colors look pretty much black when they are applied.
Great toner, unlike others I've tried it doesn't dry out your face and there's no strong odor (alcohol). Leaves skin feeling fresh and hydrated.

avis.titre: great product when using the right primer
avis.texte: the pimer they gives u really dulls everything down use sin and these are just beautiful

I have dry and sensitive skin, so it's pretty hard to find a toner. This is my 5th already, it works magic on me!! It calms and soothes my skin and redness on my face seems to have reduced since I started using it (about 3 yrs ago i think).

I managed to snag this product while it was on sale, and I'm glad I did. Very pigmented, sultry colors. The dark colored shadows are not so bright they are clownish, they add just enough color to a look to make it unique but still classy.
Finally a toner with no alcohol. Love this stuff. It deep cleans, doesn't sting and makes your face feel smooth. As far as I am concerned this is the best toner out there.

I've used Kiehl's since forever. My aunt introduced this product to me and other Keihl's products and never stopped using it. I've tried about every product out there and this one by far leaves my face feeling fresh, clean, minimizes my pores over time, and brightens my face after a long day.

My skin is combination type but my fear of oil-free toners drying out my skin led me to buy this alcohol-free cucumber toner. I love it because it works well with oily/combo skin type. What a versatile toner! It feels good and smooth after I put it on. Although some users claim that it makes your skin brighter (in fact, fresh cucumber slices give a temporary brightening effect), I have used it for more than 2 months but not seen the brightening effect yet. Anyway, this toner is at very reasonable price and lasts long (maybe 7 months). It has a neutral smell so people with sensitivity to different smells,

avis.titre: its like 4 blacks a blue and a purple...
avis.texte: When I swatched these colors they looked amazing and cobra was by far my favorite. But when I started trying to play with them on the lid they all just looked black!! Jet (the purple) makes for a good crease color and an amazing liner when wet as does Sabbath (the blue). Other than that there's not much room to play with. Def not worth the original price... sorry!

I've never used any urban decay product but I'm so glad I bought this! The quality and pigmentation are just amazing for the shadows! I've never found a Pallete were I likes all the colors! But do beware the colors go on darker than the look. Ive compared this to my Mac shadows and they went on so much better I will be buying all my shadows from urban decay from now on!

Oh my gosh! I love this palette. I have been wanting this since it first came out but I just couldn't bring myself to spend the $30 some it cost. So when this went on sale I bought it immediately and let me tell you, I use it everyday! Every morning I go to do my makeup I automatically reach for this. The blue is the best dark blue you will ever be able to find. I definitely recommend this.
Light, fresh. Smells great and non-drying. Love, love, love it

I LOVE this toner! I haven't used a toner before but thought because of my uneven skin tone that I should give it a try and I'm glad that I did! This toner doesn't dry out my already dry skin but rather it leaves my skin very supple and soft. I feel like after it gives my skin and extra deep cleanse. I usually use this at night after I use my regular cleanser. Another thing I like about this bottle is that I can take it with me if I'm traveling. It doesn't take up much space in my luggage at all. Since using this I this really gives my skin an extra oomph!

As a (soon-to-be) Professional MUA, I have to give kudos to UD for putting together a very rich, pigmented and amazing palette that I know will go a long way. As with all shadows that I've used thus far from UD, these provide a smooth application & very generous amount of product, often only needing just one stroke of the brush. In other words, if you want very bold and dramatic shadows that will last a long time - this is the palette for you! *I've attached a pic to this review of an application that I did the other day. It may seem odd to see on a guy, but I don't often have access to models and find that it's easier to just use myself. lol (I did this extreme smoky eye using Uzi (not in this set), Blackout & Sabbath.)

avis.titre: Okay, but not what I was expecting.
avis.texte: I got this because I absolutely LOVED how Cobra looked, and it was on sale-How could I pass it up? I kind of regret doing so. They all look gorgeous in pan, but they all turn black once applied. They're not easy to blend either, as they all turn muddy. Black Dog is a pretty good black, however. Better than Zero eyeshadow, but not quite as good as Blackout.

I admit that I got this just for the eyeshadow names but if you're dark eye makeup lover like me, you'll be very pleased. The colors are really pigmented and suitable for a dramatic look and the mini primer that comes with the palette is a plus. Defiitely add this to your makeup stash!

WOW! I love this palette! The matte black is so awesome, goes on so easy, not chalky at all, super easy to blend! All the other colors are fun too, easy to work with and create such a stunning look. Perfect for smokey eyes or just darker looks. The eyeliner is really nice too! So happy I bought this! Great sale price!

My cousin had this like 1yr and half ago and i love now i own mines and just got it this past week shipping was on point i used it yesterday and i must say UD stands behind there product 100% the good thing i like is how pigment the colors are with the right primer they last for a while can't go wrong and the eye liner is crazy good never thought to buy it alone for 20 bucks but it really is worth the money it last better then my benfit one if u haven't get this pallet and the others especially while their on sale

Of course, good for smokey eyes... I sometimes just wear one line of dark itself too.. The color green there is too pretty... It's my new favorite... You will definitely need to combine with other lighter shadows to get smokey look because these are all way too dark... But overall, i love it:

These colours are great for creating smokey eyes. I use them as crease colours and wet as eyeliner for dramatic looks. Four stars because I would have liked at least one lighter, shimmery colour for highlighting and blending.

This palette is great for anyone who loves dark eyeshadows (like me for night time use). The colors are so pigmented, don't fade easily, and blendable. The only downside is if ur not careful, there can be lots of fall outs, which is why i gave it average ease of use, but if you're careful, this is great. It even compliments the naked palettes if you want to combine the colors. A must buy for girls who love dark colors.
Love the colors, I highly recommend the palette is a great palette for makeup artist and anyone else who loves great eyeshadows.

The quality of the shadows in terms of payoff and such is up to UD's high standards. I use these mostly for lining and blending. The differences between the (admittedly similar) colors really shows up when blended. I'm definitely glad I bought this palette, but I thought it was an odd choice including the Eden primer. At least on my (crazy pale) skin it was too yellow to use as a base for these blacks. Perhaps it works better for other folks though?
The perfect pallet for smoky eyes. You can create the standard black smoky eye or use one of the others for a fun look. I absolutely love Cobra.

avis.titre: For the goth and glam in everyone.
avis.texte: Applied wet, these shadows are amazing. They are deep jewel tones, and I love every single one of them. I'd read several reviews of the shadows being all dark and similar, and applied dry over no base they aren't outstanding. A lighter base makes them shine, but when wet they seriously gleam. Any one is a perfect smoky eye shade. Jet looks somewhat brighter, it's an obvious dark purple while the rest of the colors seem black with a color flash. Libertine comes out deep emerald when wet, Sabbath comes out a sparkling navy, and Cobra is black with gold shimmer. Barracuda isn't amazing, it seems more charcoal than silver, wet or dry. These shadows seem a little softer than some UD shadows, so build layers slowly to avoid fallout. The soft shadow makes foiling easier, a damp brush gives you a creamy texture. Other than the shadows, the mirror is huge, the palette is medium sized and feel sturdy and tough, and snaps close with an overhanging lip, so I'm not worried about hauling it around. The eyeliner is awesome, I'll be buying a lot more of that. I'm not sure the matte primer works better with this shadow than any other, I often use Greed with these shadows and it seems to add some sparkle. But Eden does make Black Dog even more black, which is the point of the palette.
It's my go to palette when looking for complementary crease colors!

I have owned many urban decay pallets, and none are as great as this. The quality of every single shadow is like none I have seen before on an UD pallet. Each shade is rich, buttery, and super pigmented. If you buy one make up item for fall this should be it! The jewel tones are super wearable and flattering dispute their harsh appearance. You can use these in addition to the baked pallets as well to make them more day time friendly. Sexy and smokey eyes look good on everyone! Grab this before its gone!!!!

I am new to using Urban Decay products. I bought my first palette (The Black Palette) approximately two weeks ago and I fell in love with the texture, ease of application, and blendability of this brand of shadows. Since then, I have absolutely indulged myself in the purchase of all things UD! I now own the Smoked Palette, the Black Palette, Eyeshadow Ammo Palette, Deluxe Shadow Box, the Build Your Own Palette, and I just ordered the Feminine Palette! On top of this, I have also purchased several single shadows including, Woodstock, Haight, S&M, Kush, Radium, and Baked! As you can see, I have spent a lot of time and money on UD recently!
